idea-plugin.name: Consent Proof Record Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Reads the consent record your code stored and names every proof field GDPR Article 7(1) needs and your log is missing.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Consent Proof Record Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 14 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/consent-proof-record-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/consent-proof-record-lint

action.text: Consent Proof Record Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Consent Proof Record Lint on the file in the editor
